description: This file is a PHP class containing acceptance tests for the Person module in SuiteCRM/CRM application. It includes multiple test scenarios such as creating, viewing, editing, duplicating, deleting, and importing records via vCard, relying on external testing steps and page objects.

classes.name: PersonModuleCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for the Person module featuring multiple test scenarios such as creation, viewing, editing, duplication, deletion, and vCard import.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Sets up fake data generator and seed before each test.

methods.name: _after
methods.description: Teardown after each test (empty in this case).

methods.description: Test case for editing an existing record from the detail view.
